q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of brass artware and handicrafts per kg?
title: Brass artware carbon per kg
short: Add the furnace fuel for melting at its default factor, and electricity for polishing and lacquering at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, then divide by kilograms finished. Add the brass itself from the supplier, noting how much is scrap, with its own supplier figure.
audience: Brass and metal handicraft exporters and artisan clusters

ul: Brass ingot or scrap, the largest share.

p: Brass made from scrap avoids much of the mining footprint. Keep purchase records that show the share of scrap, and report it beside the figure.
Work may be split across small units. Collect fuel and power from each step, or estimate with stated assumptions and label them.

example.title: Worked example: making energy per kg (one month, illustrative inputs)
lines: Add brass ingot or scrap from supplier data, and plating chemicals if used
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; coal-fired furnaces use the coal's factor from its calorific value.
